jd.job_title: IP, EDA and SoC Ecosystem Manager
required_skills: 15+ years technical ecosystem management in semiconductor/custom silicon
Direct experience interfacing with ecosystem partners and chip development schedules
Familiarity with silicon fabrication and advanced packaging (CoWoS, InFO, 2.5D/3D)
Technical fluency in SoC and chiplet design flows
Understanding of RTL milestones, DV sign-off, PD handoffs, and silicon bringup
Strong communication skills for internal and external stakeholders
Proficiency with program tracking tools and spreadsheets
preferred_skills: Familiarity with connectivity IPs (UCIe, PCIe Gen 5/6/7+, D2D interconnect)
Experience at chiplet startup, merchant silicon, or systems company
Background in AI/ML infrastructure silicon (accelerators, network switches, CPO platforms)
Familiarity with IVR/PMIC integration challenges in advanced packaging
Exposure to EDA infrastructure programs (Synopsys/Cadence cloud flows)
key_responsibilities: Manage all active customer engagements end-to-end from architectural spec through tape-out, KGD testing, packaging, and volume shipment
Ensure alignment with ecosystem partners including foundries, OSAT/packaging houses, EDA vendors, and IP partners
Translate customer requirements into internal program plans with clear owners and dates
Build and maintain program trackers, risk registers, and executive dashboards
Drive gate reviews and weekly program syncs across RTL/DV, physical design, and validation teams
Manage internal and external scoping and delivery timelines
Identify and escalate risks early with proposed mitigations

adjacent.jd_skill: AI/ML infrastructure silicon (accelerators, network switches, CPO platforms)
adjacent.you_have: CUDA GPU kernel optimization, edge AI deployment (Jetson + TensorRT + YOLO)
